title: 美元贬值被高估？：数据说趋势暂停，接近2024年水平
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mark, in terms of the casualties of this collision of tectonic plates, it feels like the dollar is actually one of the biggest casualties. And the kind of the famous Connolly phrase,
segments.zh: 马克，在这场板块碰撞的冲击中，美元似乎是最大的受害者之一。那句著名的康纳利名言，

segments.en: our currency, your problem, feels like it's reversing a little bit, your currency, your problem.
segments.zh: “我们的货币，你们的问题”，现在感觉有点反转了，变成了“你们的货币，你们的问题”。

segments.en: I think that's absolutely true. The dollar will be the long-term sustainable victim of the various interventions in policy by the US Treasury recently combined with the new approach
segments.zh: 我认为这完全正确。美元将是美国财政部近期各种政策干预以及美联储新方法的长期受害者。

segments.en: from the FOMC. And I think, you know, this isn't a backdrop that, you know, we had a big dollar depreciation trend last year. It's kind of paused for about the last, I guess, we had it the first half of last
segments.zh: 而且，你知道，这不是一个背景，去年我们经历了美元大幅贬值趋势。大约在过去一年里，它暂停了。我想，我们去年上半年经历了这个趋势。

segments.en: year. It's paused for about a year now. I think we're now into the next big leg of that long-term downtrend and the dollar. The dollar is still an expensive currency. And I no longer feels like it offers
segments.zh: 现在大约暂停了一年。我认为我们现在进入了那个长期下行趋势的下一个大阶段。美元仍然是一种昂贵的货币。而且我不再觉得它提供了那种吸引力或优势来证明这一点，

segments.en: the attractiveness or the edge to justify that, particularly when you've got policy that's been implemented. It seems on the fly. You know, we expected Scott Besson to be kind of the adults in
segments.zh: 特别是当政策似乎是在仓促中实施的时候。你知道，我们原本期望斯科特·贝森特在政策方面能成为“房间里的大人”。

segments.en: the room when it came to policy. And I feel that impression has been very much undermined by some of the recent moves. So the dollar's back under pressure. That's financial conditions easing.
segments.zh: 但我觉得最近的一些举动已经大大削弱了这种印象。所以美元再次面临压力。那意味着金融条件宽松。

segments.en: Is that just good for assets globally? It is at its core. I mean, sorry, I shouldn't say
segments.zh: 这对全球资产来说只是好事吗？从核心上讲，是的。我的意思是，抱歉，我不应该这么说，

segments.en: and so, so tentative, but it definitely is at the headline level. You know, it isn't easy of financial conditions. And of course, you know, you have many other assets that are just are
segments.zh: 所以，这么犹豫，但在标题层面上确实如此。你知道，金融条件宽松了。当然，你还有很多其他资产，它们只是……
